title: deps(desktop): electron-builder 26 + @electron/notarize 3 to clear the critical tar advisory
body:
**Source:** the dependency triage from 2026-09-25 (major upgrades).

`bun audit` reports one critical advisory, in `tar`. The vulnerable copies are 6.2.1, pulled in by `electron-builder` 25, and no patched 6.x release exists. So the only fix is `electron-builder` 25 → 26, together with `@electron/notarize` 3. This also fixes the high-severity AppImage advisory, and we ship an AppImage.

## Work
1. Bump `electron-builder` to 26.x and `@electron/notarize` to 3.x in `apps/desktop`.
2. `notarize.cjs` loads notarize 3, which is ESM-only. Confirm Node 22 can load it; if not, rename the hook to `.mjs` and update the builder config.
3. Confirm the mac config still accepts `"notarize": false`.
4. Also move the exact `electron` pin from 40.6.0 to 40.10.6. That clears every Electron advisory listed for 40.x. `bun update` doesn't move exact pins.
5. Verify: `bun audit` shows no critical; the desktop packaging build still produces the Linux AppImage/tarball (see the desktop packaging invariants: the ABI-143 rebuild and the hardlink-free tarball).

## Acceptance
- `bun audit` reports 0 critical.
- The desktop build succeeds on Linux, and the packaged app starts.
- The PR notes any change to the notarize hook.
